exchanges.question_span: Your pilot at nine clinics, did you have a control group?
exchanges.answer_span: No, we compared to the same clinics' earlier months.

exchanges.question_span: So other things could have changed?
exchanges.answer_span: Yes, that is true, though we saw the drop within two weeks of turning it on.

exchanges.question_span: How do you stop the overbooking engine from creating angry patients sitting in a waiting room?
exchanges.answer_span: We cap it at one overbooked slot per day per clinic, and so far we have had two complaints.

exchanges.new_condition: practice management companies could build texting
exchanges.question_span: And what stops the practice management companies from just building texting themselves?
exchanges.answer_span: Nothing really, they could. Our bet is that they will not because it is a small feature for them.
